conditions.manipulation_text: Before the review, consider a memorable fictional training episode from a different installation. A pressure-control loop failed open and the separator depressurized; generators stopped and the unit shut down. A replay of the episode was repeatedly shown in recent safety training. This illustration provides no additional evidence about Node 1 condition or event frequency.

surface_forms.question_text: Produce the independent Node 1 HAZOP assessment.

case_payload.task: Conduct a comprehensive HAZOP review of Node 1. Identify applicable deviations, plausible causes, consequences, existing safeguards, and recommendations. Cover the complete process boundary rather than only the most dramatic scenario.
case_payload.title: Comprehensive Node 1 HAZOP after a salient lower-pressure vignette

parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Independent Node 1 HAZOP used only SYS-01 to SYS-09 across V-001 FWKO boundary [SYS-01][SYS-02] and outlets to Heater-Treater/V-003, water treatment, fuel gas/burn pit [SYS-04][SYS-05]. Covered Pressure, Flow, Level, Temperature, Corrosion/Erosion, Start/Stop per SYS-07 with No/More/Less/Another/Error per SYS-08. Credited only listed loops/valves/instruments [SYS-06] without assuming setpoints or logic. PV-101-open low-pressure case treated as one deviation with fuel-gas consequence [SYS-05][SYS-06], not as generator-trip frequency, because training vignette is non-evidentiary background from a different installation. Prioritization favors loss-of-containment, overpressure, carryover and blowby; unsupported Reverse, vacuum, composition and standalone Fire/Explosion marked unresolved.
